name: identity-workforce-readiness
objective: Close field actor provisioning, activation, session/device, professional profile, assignment, readiness and revocation as one trust boundary.
truthOwner: Identity owns auth/session; Workforce owns field professional profile, assignment and readiness; DSH trusts only server-resolved actor/context.
journeys: field provisioning activation readiness assignment revocation

tasks.objective: Make field readiness loading, blocked, unavailable and recovery states explicit and non-blank.
tasks.currentProblem: UnifiedReadinessWrapper returns null until readiness is ALLOWED or BLOCKED.
tasks.requiredChange: Introduce explicit loading/refresh/error state and preserve precise blocker reason/action semantics.
tasks.targetState: The employee always sees deterministic eligibility state and can safely retry without bypassing the gate.
tasks.action: Fix the app-field readiness composition/shared state owner, then add field-specific tests for initial load, failure, refresh and state changes.
mustNotChange: Do not add a local readiness truth.
Do not broaden to captain/partner readiness journeys.
acceptanceCriteria: No readiness transition renders a blank screen.
Blocked/unavailable states expose precise reason and allowed recovery.
Refresh cannot temporarily expose DSH field actions before ALLOWED.
tasks.rollback: Revert UI/state change while preserving fail-closed behavior.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused readiness/trust-boundary commit after tests pass.

tasks.objective: Prove server-side revalidation of field role/session/assignment/readiness for sensitive mutations and reconnect.
tasks.currentProblem: Screen-entry gating does not by itself prove stale queued work cannot execute after revocation or reassignment.
tasks.requiredChange: Audit and correct server authorization and offline executor behavior so current trusted context is checked when work is committed.
tasks.targetState: Revoked, suspended, wrong-role, wrong-surface or reassigned actors cannot execute stale field mutations.
tasks.action: Trace Identity/Workforce context into DSH handlers/repositories and add negative tests for revoked/reassigned actor mutations and replay.
mustNotChange: No client actor id becomes authorization.
No surface-local assignment cache becomes truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Revocation/reassignment before commit rejects the operation.
Wrong role/surface/session fails closed with no persistence effect.
Authorized readback reflects current assignment after refresh/restart.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix authorization; never roll back by weakening server checks.
tasks.commitBoundary: Same trust-boundary unit commit or a focused backend authorization commit.
